video_title: Should Grimes Start for the Lakers? | Are the Thunder Wasting Their Window?

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder unlikely to make major roster upgrades this season
quotes.excerpt: there's a sense that the Thunder are happy with the way things are going. They're not going to do anything drastic to upgrade the roster.
quotes.quote: I want to talk about the Thunder and they've hit a little skid, nothing crazy. They lost the baseball series in Portland. They're nine and five. We're so used to them starting seasons like 17 and one and stuff, so it's like, is it panic time? But our guy Sam Presti did a report where he talked to people around the league and there's a sense that the Thunder are happy with the way things are going. They're not going to do anything drastic to upgrade the roster.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper's groin injury impacts Thunder's offensive development
quotes.excerpt: Dylan Harper goes down with what appears to be a groin injury. I think this has major implications for the team's offensive development.
quotes.quote: The big news coming out of this is Dylan Harper goes down with what appears to be a groin injury after taking an awkward fall. I think this has major implications for the team's offensive development and how they allocate the ball-handling and playmaking duties when, where, why, and how between the three guards, the three-headed monster. So I do think this is a setback.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper's on-off numbers show significant impact on Thunder
quotes.excerpt: plus 22 points per 100 possessions with him on, minus 9.9 with him off, so that's a wild swing.
quotes.quote: I agree. And if you look at the on-off numbers with Harper this season, plus 22 points per 100 possessions with him on, minus 9.9 with him off, so that's a wild swing. It's not quite Wemby level, but it is stark. I think he's their second-best player to me, the best of those three guards, and he's been coming into his own this season.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Stefan Castle's limitations as a primary point guard
quotes.excerpt: Stefan Castle, he's nobody's point guard. He's an off-guard who can handle the rock.
quotes.quote: You see that Stefan Castle, he's nobody's point guard. He's an off-guard who can handle the rock. I'm not saying he's some dude you can't trust to run pick and roll every now and again, but I just think against the most elite defenses, I don't think he cuts the muster in terms of playmaking.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: D'Aaron Fox should move to the bench for long-term success
quotes.excerpt: I think D'Aaron Fox should clearly become an off-the-bench player and you lean into Castle and Harper.
quotes.quote: I'm maybe against the norm in that I think D'Aaron Fox should clearly become an off-the-bench player and you lean into Castle and Harper because longer term, what is the core of this group three years from now? I'm confident it's Wemby, Harper, and Castle. And that's a long-term trio here. I think D'Aaron Fox, it's more of a short-term situation.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Adding a pure shooter like Champagnie improves team balance
quotes.excerpt: Throw Champagnie in there as another pure shooter with Devin Vassell, now you got two shooters instead of one.
quotes.quote: Throw Champagnie in there as another pure shooter with Devin Vassell, now you got two shooters instead of one, who defenses have to be scared shitless to leave. And you do anything around the Wemby pick and roll or just Wemby anything, it's going to be a lot more effective.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Wemby's non-playing minutes are a major issue for the team
quotes.excerpt: The non-Wemby minutes have been a huge problem for them. It's been a trend all season.
quotes.quote: The non-Wemby minutes have been a huge problem for them. And even looking at last night, plus 6 with Wemby on the floor in a game that they lost by 12, so minus 18 in the 14 minutes he was off the floor. This has been a trend all season. And Luke Kornet, he got his praise last year as one of the better backups, but he's just looking cooked defensively this season.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wemby needs to play 40 minutes in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: To me, the answer is Wemby, you got to play 40 minutes a night in the playoffs.
quotes.quote: To me, the answer is Wemby, you got to play 40 minutes a night in the playoffs. That's what LeBron did. That's the answer. That's what LeBron did in his prime. You play 40 minutes a night, you don't worry about the load management.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Wemby's current load management and minutes restriction
quotes.excerpt: Right now he's averaging 30, and they've been like load managing.
quotes.quote: Right now he's averaging 30, and they've been like load managing. And I understand to some degree with the size and the, you know, you got to get him to the playoffs in one piece, but yeah, it's a big jump up.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Quentin Grimes' performance and his mother's birthday
quotes.excerpt: Quentin Grimes, man. I don't know if you got to talk to him or if he took questions.
quotes.quote: Quentin Grimes, man. I don't know if you got to talk to him or if he took questions after the game. Was he on cloud nine? He was. It was just his mom's 60th birthday, so he had a nice moment with her after the game where he took his jersey off, gave it to her.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Quentin Grimes' career-high performance against the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: Quentin Grimes, out-of-body experience, 47 points, career high, becomes just the second Laker outside of Kobe to hit 10 plus threes.
quotes.quote: Quentin Grimes, out-of-body experience, 47 points, career high, becomes just the second Laker outside of Kobe to hit 10 plus threes in a game for the franchise. So it was just a ridiculous game. He basically made every shot. It was just absurd.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Quentin Grimes' performance as a starter vs. bench player
quotes.excerpt: As a starter across four games, he's averaging 26 points per game, shooting 56% overall and 61% on threes.
quotes.quote: As a starter across four games, he's averaging 26 points per game, shooting 56% overall and 61% on threes. That's heavily skewed by last night's performance, but off the bench, he's averaging 6 points per game, 45% shooting and 24% on threes.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Matisse Thybulle's defensive impact and starting role
quotes.excerpt: It would have to come at the expense of Matisse Thybulle, who right now is second in the league in steals.
quotes.quote: It would have to come at the expense of Matisse Thybulle, who right now is second in the league in steals, second in the league in deflections. He's been awesome defensively. He's played well enough to maintain his starting spot, so it's it's kind of tricky there.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Quentin Grimes' training relationship with JJ
quotes.excerpt: Quentin Grimes has trained with JJ. He reached out to him a few summers ago.
quotes.quote: Quentin Grimes has trained with JJ. He reached out to him a few summers ago. He actually stayed at his house over the summer. So they have a good dynamic there. But it was interesting, if you go back to media day, Quentin Grimes said at media day that he wanted to start.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's performance and foul trouble against the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: Last night, I think was probably Luka's worst game of the season. He had 36 points on 34 shots.
quotes.quote: Last night, I think was probably Luka's worst game of the season. I know people, well he had 36, well the guy took 34 shots. Some of them were just nasty and ugly. He did a lot of the nasty foul baiting, oh he's crying at the refs, blah blah blah. What I will say again, and I got to call a spade a spade, man, this guy has been busting his ass on defense and even last night, he continued to do so.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's defensive effort and switchability
quotes.excerpt: He was getting switched and he was holding his own and either stopping the penetration or funneling guys.
quotes.quote: He was getting switched and he was holding his own and either stopping the penetration or funneling guys to certain spots where the help was. Like I think he's been, that's been an underrated thing is like, I think with Luka, the narrative is that he's a bottom 10th, 15th percentile defender.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' roster depth and potential trade assets
quotes.excerpt: They've got 10 first-round picks and 19 second-round picks. You're telling me there's not someone that you can send three or four second-round picks to?
quotes.quote: They've got 10 first-round picks and 19 second-round picks. You're telling me there's not someone that you can send three or four second-round picks to to pry a at least like a good bench player and just continue to bolster your depth? Like that's what I'd be looking for at a minimum. I I just think standing pat to me, especially like they need more perimeter size.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' championship window and roster management
quotes.excerpt: They've only won one title and when we think about the top executives of all time, all those guys have multiple championships.
quotes.quote: They've only won one title and when we think about the top executives of all time and we discuss who are the best architects of their generation, all those guys have multiple championships. And at some point, like if they don't win another title in the next five years, we are looking at sure, amazing 20-year run, like undeniable, they they them having and doing so with multiple eras.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr.'s content creation and influencer status
quotes.excerpt: This man is a generational podcaster and that's Michael Porter Jr. He's just a content genius.
quotes.quote: This man is a generational podcaster and that's Michael Porter Jr. He's just a content genius. I don't know what else to say. So this is from his latest episode, Yovan. So you're married, I'm engaged to be married. That's happening this summer, guys. Don't worry, it's actually going to happen. And Mike had a Instagram model influencer, DJ, a woman named Summer Ray. Not familiar with her work, but I'm sure she's incredible.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre's perspective on marriage and life events
quotes.excerpt: I think if God forbid, if Elena got into a bad accident, I think you guys would stick together.
quotes.quote: I think if God forbid, if Elena got into a bad accident, I think you guys would stick together. But I think the and I would stick with my fiance too. I I would I would tough it out. It wouldn't be some like, all right, I'm getting out of here. I'd be toughing it out and all of that. But like, how short is short enough to bounce?

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of emotional support during difficult times in relationships
quotes.excerpt: You pass the keys off to the family members in terms of the emotional support, the day-to-day.
quotes.quote: We have to be honest here. If you guys have never even moved in together, it is looking like this. Even if you guys were together for 15 months, you have to, like, bro, I am taking some time to myself. That is it. You pass the keys off to the family members in terms of the emotional support, the day-to-day. Then you do spend some months because you care about, you want to show that I am there for you. I am going to the hospital. I am showing up to a couple of rehabs.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: The complexity of ending a relationship during a partner's health crisis
quotes.excerpt: I am taking some time to myself. That is it. And then that time just becomes permanent.
quotes.quote: You come in and you say, yo, I am taking some time to myself. I am taking some time to myself. And then that time just becomes permanent. That is what it is. You got marriage and kids and all of that. I think you got to go through it with the family for sure. You know, marriage, kids, like the mother of your child, I think that is a crazy example to be setting to your kid, like, yo, I am a guy that cuts and runs when things get tough.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr.'s impact on societal discussions and his legacy
quotes.excerpt: This man, he is going to go down in the annals of greatest Howard Stern, Charlemagne the God.
quotes.quote: Porter Jr. is just, he is tackling the hard-hitting societal questions head-on and this man, he is going to go down in the annals of greatest Howard Stern, Charlemagne the God, you know, all of these greats, Michael Porter Jr., Joe Rogan. He is going down in the annals, man. That is our show for today. Shout out to Tony Mays on the ones and threes, keeping the trains running on time.
